answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral, but correlated equivocation across k identities is clustered by shared evidence and penalized at O(k^2), rapidly exhausting the escrow anchor. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier applies to the swarm’s capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation makes unrecoverable stake exceed any gain from forged votes. An evidence thread links signatures, and a withdrawal ledge delays escape.
